question: Where is Robo Inc. opening its 66,000-square-foot manufacturing facility?

hits.title: RoboStore launches Robo Inc. to help U.S. organizations deploy robots - The Robot Report
hits.snippet: Robo Inc. plans to open a 66,000-sq.-ft. (6,131.6-sq.-m) production facility on Long Island in New York. The company expects it to be fully operational by the first quarter of 2027.

hits.title: RoboStore to Advance U.S. Localization of Robotics with Launch of Robo Inc.
hits.snippet: PLAINVIEW, N.Y., Aug. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- RoboStore, a leading distributor of foreign humanoid and quadruped robots in North America, today announced the public launch of Robo Inc., a U.S.-based robotics manufacturing and systems integration company built to help organizations deploy practical robotic solutions in America. As the U.S. races to strengthen domestic manufacturing and secure critical technologies, Robo Inc. will open a 66,000-square-foot facility on Long Island, New York, which is expected to be fully operational by Q1 2027. ... About Robo Inc.Robo Inc. is a U.S.-based robotics manufacturing and systems integration company building deployable, application-specific solutions through a global-to-local operating model. The company combines global robotics platforms and components with U.S.-based engineering, software, integration, security and safety testing, production, service and support. Its planned 66,000-square-foot facility on Long Island, New York, is expected to begin producing U.S.-localized robotic solutions in January 2027.

hits.title: RoboStore Spins Out Robo Inc. as U.S. Robotics Manufacturer to Navigate Trade Restrictions | RobotsBeat
hits.snippet: Robo Inc. has been operating in stealth for a year. It plans to open a 66,000 square-foot production facility on Long Island in New York, expected to be fully operational by Q1 2027.
